# MetaWebMCP

> MetaWebMCP is a WebMCP application that observes website interfaces, creates narrow semantic tools, activates them for the current session, verifies them against visible state, and exports the same contracts as native integration code.

The live workspace exposes seven permanent `meta_*` WebMCP tools. A completed build adds reviewed, domain-specific tools to the same top-level registry without adding WebMCP to the target page. The controlled Relay Sessions demo is deterministic; Any public site mode uses an isolated Browser MCP runtime.

## Primary links

- [Live workspace](https://metawebmcp.neuryta.com/)
- [Source and setup](https://github.com/scanchila/MetaWebMCP)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/scanchila/MetaWebMCP/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Security model](https://github.com/scanchila/MetaWebMCP/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Validation report](https://github.com/scanchila/MetaWebMCP/blob/main/TEST_REPORT.md)

## Core workflow

1. Observe a controlled, owned, or public target.
2. Review evidence-backed capability candidates.
3. Shape and activate semantic WebMCP tools.
4. Execute and verify the generated surface.
5. Export a standalone native repository.
